snippet.title: Bellestrelle ft. Harry Azrul - Jiwa Yang Mengalah (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Jiwa Yang Mengalah merupakan sebuah perjalanan penuh emosi yang menggambarkan perjuangan senyap yang ramai alami di sebalik kehidupan seharian. Dipersembahkan oleh Bellestrelle featuring Harry Azrul, lagu ini menyelami tekanan emosi, kesunyian, dan kesakitan yang sering tersembunyi daripada pandangan orang lain.
Melalui lirik yang mendalam dan penyampaian yang penuh penghayatan, Jiwa Yang Mengalah menceritakan kisah seseorang yang berjuang memikul beban kehidupan sambil menyembunyikan luka di sebalik senyuman. Bahagian yang dibawakan oleh Harry Azrul menyampaikan mesej ketabahan dan kekuatan, mengingatkan pendengar bahawa walaupun berada dalam kegelapan, masih ada sinar harapan untuk terus melangkah.
Lagu ini ditujukan kepada mereka yang berasa hilang arah, terbeban, atau tidak difahami. Jiwa Yang Mengalah menjadi peringatan bahawa setiap perjuangan yang tidak terlihat berhak menerima kasih sayang dan empati, serta tiada siapa yang sepatutnya menghadapi pertempuran hidup seorang diri.
"Jiwa Yang Mengalah" oleh Bellestrelle featuring Harry Azrul ialah sebuah balada emosi yang mengisahkan kesakitan yang tersembunyi, pergolakan mental, dan pencarian harapan di tengah-tengah tekanan kehidupan. Satu peringatan yang kuat bahawa pertempuran yang berlaku dalam diri sering kali merupakan perjuangan yang tidak dapat dilihat oleh sesiapa.

Verse 1
Hari demi hari aku terus melangkah
Walau hati retak tak siapa yang kisah
Penat aku simpan semua tekanan
Senyum tiada seri hidup tiada erti

Kamu tak tahu perang yang aku lawan
Jiwaku mengamuk, ku menahan beban
Penat aku simpan semua tekanan
Senyum tiada seri, hidup tiada erti

Chorus
Tekanan yang datang
Menghukumi diriku, hilang jalan pulang
Bebanan yang datang buat aku hilang
Aku ingin pulang

Post-Chorus
Kalau mereka tahu apa dalam dada
Mungkin mereka takkan bercakap sewenang wenangnya
Aku sakit, tapi aku sembunyi..
Sebab dunia tak faham sakit yang tak nampak di hati.

Harry Azrul
Dalam gelap, ku belajar berdiri
Tak tunggu siapa, datang slamatkan hati
Beribu kata pedih pernah di telan

snippet.title: The Search For The Leviathan
snippet.description:
In the last few months, hundreds of reports have appeared all over the internet, all claiming to see the same thing in their Minecraft oceans - a sea monster called The Leviathan. But is it just a massive hoax, or is there something more to it? I'm going to find out.

Voice of Hummer:  @schpoody 
Voice of Arronax:  @jumperwho 

ORIGINAL MUSIC BY: Ben Bracey (@benbraceymusic on instagram)
https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original

Download all the builds in this video for $5 on both Java and Bedrock!!: https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan  



DO NOT READ BELOW FOR SPOILERS:


Well well well here we are again. I think this video is interesting in that the first 12 minutes can't prepare you for the remaining hour; as in the pacing is very different/the style totally shifts. So we'll see how that goes...

I'm really fond of the ending I like how that last 10 minutes turned out. That final scene with hummer was inspired by one of my favorite short stories, "Hell is the Absence of God" by Ted Chiang. There are definitely some parts of the video that I think could be a little better like maybe the dialogue is a bit dragged but overall I'm pretty satisfied with the majority of the video. 

Thematically, I think you might be able to tell the kind of story I was playing around with, but I was also hugely inspired by the Lochness Monster. Probably some of my favorite parts of research for this video was reading the Lochness Monster wiki and learning more about the kind of theories/tools people use to look for it. The F3 scene on hummer's boat was inspired by all the sonar and stuff people use to check for Nessie.

Also just a MASSIVE shoutout to schpood for all the hours and care he poured into this video. I'm so thankful for the enthusiasm and feedback he gave and the video would be so much worse without him. And thank you to my discord server members for making (almost) all of the fake reports you see in this video. They were super creative and did a way better job than I could have.
